title: Incredible, a ten for Jordan and the flamenco group
text: It is an impressive show. The guitar, the three dancers, and the singer made this show a unique and memorable experience. But the kind and special touch goes to Jordan, who took great care of us and helped my mother, who was in a wheelchair, immensely. A ten, and please do not miss it. Thank you very much for this very special memory.
author: josefina1972

title: Wonderful and Authentic!
text: This felt very authentic! It’s a small space, so even though it is not a cave, you are up close with the performers. They were so incredibly talented and passionate. Our 9 year old and 7 year old enjoyed it just as much as the adults. Would highly recommend.
